Any advice for something to do in the break while I'm at the cafe? I try just to be present but 10min a lot!

Great question. I actually think it’s good to allow yourself to be bored during those 10 minutes. 😊

Use the break to let your brain recover: grab some water or a coffee, get a bit of fresh air, stretch, or simply sit and do nothing for a moment.

The worst thing you can do is jump back onto social media or start scrolling on your phone—that keeps your brain stimulated instead of giving it the recovery time it needs.

I might even make a guided break video in the future if that’s something people would find useful.
